quests.title: Valor's Afterglow

dialogue.t: Do you need something?

dialogue.sit: Tell me about your life as an adventurer.
What do you think about Clitopho?

dialogue.t: Eh? My maps? There's honestly not much to be said about them. Before I joined the Adventurers' Guild, I was the mine cartographer.
Of course, I wasn't just some person sitting behind a desk... In fact, we couldn't be more different.
I was once commissioned by them to map out the terrain of Qiaoying Village... and after all that work, they canceled the construction project just like that, with only a word.
People like them get assistants to do the dirty exploration work and information-gathering for them, and then they start drawing... But those like me? We can't do that.
As... well, half a miner myself, I've long gotten used to passing through the dangerous underground passages. It's just the way the job works.
Also, after that great change, the lower levels of The Chasm have really been truly unstable.
Eh? Unstable? Is that very dangerous?
You bet it is. The terrain here is slowly but constantly changing. A path today might be a rock wall next month. It's almost as if... How should I say this...
It's almost as if The Chasm itself is changing shape as it likes.
Uh... things can't be that spooky, right?
Hello, {NICKNAME}! How have things been?

dialogue.sit: Pretty good. Are you feeling better?
Well, still alive in spite of everything. How are you doing?

dialogue.t: Thanks for your concern. I'm quite fine now, thanks. I'm sorry for causing you trouble before.
C'mon, Zhiqiong, just stop running around everywhere already, or you'll end up like you did the last time.
Alright, I won't. Thanks to your efforts, The Chasm has become a lot safer. The geological peculiarities here have also, well, stabilized a fair bit.
However, Jinwu and Khedive still need to conduct further analysis on that mysterious crystal's... Uh...
Wavelength, I think Khedive called it? I guess it's just some sort of weird Sumeru jargon. Whatever the case, we need to plant some beacons and get some of that data.
Jinwu finally found the time to put those beacons together, and I need to put them down in a few specific locations to get the data we need.
After a while, we can go and collect them, and Khedive will then sift through the data obtained.
Previously, there were too many hazardous areas for us to do anything but perform data analysis from our campsite...
But now that you've cleared much of the way for us, we can use the beacons to get more accurate data.
*sigh* Well, having something to do is better than having nothing at all on your plate. Ah, right! Do you mind coming with me if you're free?

dialogue.sit: Sooo, what's in it for me?

dialogue.t: Alright then, let's go!
Well, thanks for your help! Please, take this as a little token of appreciation.
Well, the various geological anomalies have mostly stopped lately, which means that I've just needed to make some small amendments to my maps.
Thanks to your adventures, our work has become a lot easier, too.
Ah, don't let me keep you any longer. Whether you need some rest or would like to continue your adventures, please, go ahead!
It's going to be a while before we will go and retrieve the beacons. It'll be nice if you could help us out then, too!

quests.description: Although the incident in The Chasm has come to a close, Zhiqiong is still involved in other exploration work. Best you go check in on her…
